lines.en: \c[1]The Sea Shepherd, far out at sea from Port Jenos\c[0]
lines.zh: \c[1]海上牧羊人号，远离热诺斯港的海域\c[0]

lines.en: Alright, here we are, on the edge of a bleedin' storm in the middle of the Herald Sea.  Well, there's the storm, then there's the bloodthirsty outlaws...
lines.zh: 好吧，我们在这前不着村后不着店的先驱海中央，还紧挨着一个该死的风暴。 一边是风暴，一边是一群刀口舔血的亡命之徒……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Can we catch up to the Tidereaver ships?
lines.zh: 我们能不能赶上噬浪海盗团的船？

lines.en: They ain't movin'.  Probably hunkered down to ride out the storm.  Wait a minute... you're...
lines.zh: 他们没有动。 可能是打算停船度过风暴吧。 等等……你是想……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en:
If we don't make an example of them now, we're going to keep getting pushed around.
We can also free the prisoners and treasure they plundered from Port Jenos.
We trust you, Protagonist.  I will fight the cult and their pawns no matter where.
lines.zh: 我们相信你的判断，Protagonist。 我会与邪教和它的爪牙们战到天涯海角。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Hell's bells, Protagonist...  I hope I don't find m'self on yer bad side someday.
lines.zh: 真可怕，Protagonist…… 希望我不会有成为你的敌人的那天。
lines.name: 斯泰凡
